get.description: merchant:merchant:read plus current authorized entity scope. Supplying either query parameter enables order_no ascending operator pagination; limit defaults to20 in pagination mode. Omit both to preserve the legacy recent100 list. No financial mutation.

parameters.name: afterOrderNo
parameters.description: Exclusive last orderNo from prior page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Use20 for standard pages. Omit both pagination parameters for legacy behavior.

CashReceipt.description: Verified real cash from the payment ledger, independent of order quote. Pending refunds reserve refundable capacity.

CashRefundRequest.description: Refund the full remaining balance of this verified original payment. Amount, currency and original payment identity are frozen by the server.

paidOutAt.description: Whole-second actual outgoing transfer time, no later than now.

CashRefundPayout.description: Record an actual bank transfer; does not execute one. Requires stored private REFUND_PROOF. Replay the same actionNo with the exact original command; correct explicit rejection using a new actionNo.

CashRefundView.description: Buyer-safe progress only; excludes platform proof, payee identifiers and bank references. REFUNDED requires a verified complete refund fact. HTTP success alone is not refund completion.
